brief: As this unit is an ageing asset with warm nights, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended before the event. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward.
